mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary easing reduces cost of capital for corporate cash flows.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.5 percentage points over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% for two consecutive months signals labor market deterioration, triggering equity sell-offs due to reduced consumer spending and corporate profit expectations over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) by at least 1% from prior month indicate consumer demand contraction, causing negative equity returns over 20 trading days as sales forecasts deteriorate.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by at least 1% from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing contraction (INDPRO below 100) signals industrial output weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as corporate earnings forecasts adjust downward for prolonged economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained GDP growth (GDPC1) exceeding 1.0% annually signals expanding economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days through improved corporate earnings and risk appetite.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 1.0% annually.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals imminent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days as bond yields rise and equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate increases (>0.2pp) and employment declines (>0.5%) indicate labor market deterioration, triggering negative equity returns over 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending power.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE rises >0.2pp and PAYEMS falls >0.5% from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Active monetary easing (FEDFUNDS below 4.0% and declining) supports positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days by maintaining low discount rates and liquidity for equity valuation expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0% and declining.
